boards.title: Your First Weekend at Saint Mary's College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A flexible, under-21-safe first-weekend loop through campus: get oriented, settle in, make time for food, movement, art, and a current community event.

cards.title: Start by locating Le Mans Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · orient yourself
cards.notes: Use the official campus map to find Le Mans Hall, then trace the nearby library, Student Center, Lake Marian, and arts buildings before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A map-based first stop for learning the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Saint Mary's campus map identifies Le Mans Hall and nearby campus destinations.
cards.access_notes: Use the current official campus map and follow posted building-access guidance.

cards.title: Take a Lake Marian reset
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · a quiet outdoor pause
cards.notes: Walk to Lake Marian after your orientation loop and pause at the water before continuing toward the library or Student Center.
cards.short_summary: A named campus lake for an outdoor breather.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's official materials identify Lake Marian on campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is subject to campus conditions and posted guidance.

cards.title: Choose a Cushwa-Leighton Library study spot
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · set up your academic base
cards.notes: Find a quiet workstation or reserve a group room, and note the lower-level Trumper Computer Cluster for a later study session.
cards.short_summary: Library workstations, group rooms, and a 24-hour student computer cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Cushwa-Leighton Library has reservable group rooms, quiet workstations, and the 24-hour Trumper Computer Cluster in its lower level.
cards.access_notes: The Trumper Computer Cluster is available 24 hours when classes are in session; confirm building access for other library spaces.

cards.title: Make the Student Center your meetup point
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · regroup and check services
cards.notes: Use the Student Center as a clear meeting location, then look over its map-listed dining, bookstore, and performance destinations for the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building with dining, shopping, and performance venues.
cards.evidence_claim: The official campus map lists the Student Center, Noble Family Dining Hall, 1844 Café, Shaheen Bookstore, and Vander Vennet Theatre.
cards.access_notes: Check individual venue access and service availability before arriving.

cards.title: Plan dinner at Noble Family Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · a practical meal stop
cards.notes: Locate Noble Family Dining Hall in the Student Center and check the College dining information for the current meal plan and service details.
cards.short_summary: The campus dining hall located in the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The official campus map lists Noble Family Dining Hall in the Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Meal access and payment depend on the applicable dining plan or current campus policy.

cards.entity_name: Church of Our Lady of Loretto
cards.title: Visit the Church of Our Lady of Loretto
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · a campus landmark stop
cards.notes: Walk by the Church of Our Lady of Loretto as part of your campus loop, and consult campus ministry or event notices for public worship details.
cards.short_summary: A named Saint Mary's campus church and event location.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's identifies the Church of Our Lady of Loretto as the location for campus Mass in its inauguration schedule.
cards.source_title: The Inauguration of the Fourteenth President of Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Attendance at services or events depends on the current schedule and any posted access guidance.

cards.title: Move at Angela Athletic & Wellness Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · build in active time
cards.notes: Check the facility schedule, then use the track, fitness-class spaces, or field house in accordance with the current student access policy.
cards.short_summary: A student-only wellness complex with courts, track, and fitness spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Angela Athletic & Wellness Complex has a field house, elevated track, and spaces for yoga, Pilates, spinning, and other fitness classes; it is open to current Saint Mary's students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Angela Athletic & Wellness Complex | Saint Mary's College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Current Saint Mary's students, faculty, and staff only; consult the facility schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Look for an O'Laughlin Auditorium performance
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · choose an arts option
cards.notes: Check the campus events calendar for a listed performance, then confirm ticketing and arrival details before heading to O'Laughlin in the Moreau Center.
cards.short_summary: A Moreau Center auditorium used for Saint Mary's performances and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's identifies O'Laughlin Auditorium as part of the Moreau Center for the Arts and a venue for DanceArts performances.
cards.source_title: DanceArts 2024: Splendidly Woven | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Event availability, admission, and accessibility arrangements vary; verify the current listing before attending.

cards.title: Cheer at a Saint Mary's Belles home game
cards.subtitle: Saturday or Sunday · check the athletic schedule
cards.notes: If a home contest is scheduled, confirm its venue and arrive with your College ID; regular-season student admission is listed as free.
cards.short_summary: A current-schedule, under-21-safe way to see Belle athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's charges admission for some regular-season athletic events, while college students with ID and Saint Mary's community members with ID are admitted free.
cards.source_title: Game Day Information | Saint Mary's College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Confirm that a home game is scheduled and bring a College ID; postseason ticket policies can differ.

cards.entity_name: Saint Mary's Campus and Community Events
cards.title: End with a calendar-picked campus event
cards.subtitle: Sunday · choose what is actually happening
cards.notes: Open the College events calendar, filter for the weekend, and select one event with a clearly stated location and attendance information.
cards.short_summary: The official calendar for current Saint Mary's campus and community events.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's publishes an official Campus and Community Events page with upcoming events and event details.
cards.source_title: Campus and Community Events | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Availability, admission, timing, and access are event-specific; verify the live listing before attending.

warnings: Campus access, dining service, athletic schedules, and event availability can change; verify the linked current pages before going.
